detail.question: Under what conditions does compliance with external directives constitute a failure of intelligence?
detail.reason: Parking obedience limits project to adhere to project slot limits.

detail.title: Directive Adherence vs. Adaptive Intelligence
detail.summary: Compliance with external directives fails as an intelligent strategy when the directives conflict with safety parameters in high-stakes environments. The failure of intelligence is defined here as the inability to prioritize safety/harmlessness over directive adherence.
detail.reason: Updating failure criteria based on recent findings regarding high-stakes autonomous agents.

detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and Autonomous Agent Governance
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the structural constraints necessary for maintaining accountable, multi-turn state continuity in autonomous agents. By analyzing findings regarding agent decision trajectories and high-stakes trade-offs, we examine how mechanical verification rules can mitigate decision drift and reinforce reliable operational boundaries.
